§aGot a bunch of flammable fluids sitting around? Burn them for heat.§f

The Fluid Burner sits under a crucible or any TU-hungry machine and converts flammable fluids into thermal energy. Place it so the copper heat plate lines up with the machine above.

Crafted at the Tier 2 Anvil from steel tanks, steel pipes, titanium ingots, and red copper.

It holds 16,000 mB of fluid and stores up to 100,000 TU before stopping. The burn rate is adjustable from 1 to 100 mB/t using a screwdriver. Four fluid ports on the lower block let you pipe fluids in from any side.

The block displays consumption and heat output right on the face, no GUI needed.

§ePS:§f This bridges the gap between solid-fuel fireboxes and electric heaters. Perfect for those oil byproducts you've been stockpiling.
